name: Create a custom asset
description: Create a custom asset Creates a new custom asset at the account level. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets
Creates a new custom asset at the account level.
Required: account_identifier (path); body (body)

name: Delete a custom asset
description: Delete a custom asset Deletes an existing custom asset. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets/{asset_name}

name: Get a custom asset
description: Get a custom asset Fetches the details of a custom asset. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets/{asset_name}

name: List custom assets
description: List custom assets Fetches all the custom assets at the account level. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets
Fetches all the custom assets at the account level.
Required: account_identifier (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update a custom asset
description: Update a custom asset Updates the configuration of an existing custom asset. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/assets/{asset_name}

name: Create a preview token
description: Create a preview token Creates a signed JWT token used to preview custom pages before they are published. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/preview_tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/preview_tokens
Creates a signed JWT token used to preview custom pages before they are published.
Required: account_identifier (path); body (body)

name: Get a custom page
description: Get a custom page Fetches the details of a custom page. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages/{identifier}

name: List custom pages
description: List custom pages Fetches all the custom pages at the account level. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_identifier}/custom_pages
Fetches all the custom pages at the account level.
